_comment: Static reference data for each cruise line's price-drop / price-protection policy. Sourced from https://cruisesignal.app/coverage. Used by the scraper (to decide whether a detected price drop is currently claimable) and by the Android app's Claims screen. Update when a cruise line changes its policy.

lines.monitoring: Public fares matching ship, sail date, and stateroom category. Royal Caribbean-owned booking channels only.

policies.name: 24-Hour Upgrade Window
policies.notes: Applies only in the 24 hours immediately after making a payment.

exclusions: Non-refundable fares only match to other non-refundable prices
lines.eligibility: U.S. and Canadian residents only; must be same currency.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Royal Caribbean.

lines.monitoring: Public Carnival pricing across two separate guarantee programs.

policies.name: Early Saver
policies.notes: Refund or onboard credit, valid up to 2 business days before sailing.

policies.name: 110% Lowest Price Guarantee
policies.notes: Non-refundable OBC equal to 110% of the difference, valid 48 hours post-booking.

exclusions: Not offered on Carnival Australia sailings
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Carnival.

policies.name: Better Than Best Price Guarantee
policies.outcomeDetail: 120% of the difference, capped at US$2,000 onboard credit. Non-refundable, expires at end of cruise.
policies.notes: Before final payment only; bundle matching required.

lines.eligibility: U.S./Canadian residents in matching currency; Princess.com bookings only.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer before the final payment deadline.

policies.name: Repricing
policies.notes: Fare is repriced down to the new lower public fare.

policies.name: 48-Hour OBC
policies.outcomeDetail: 100% of the difference as onboard credit. Forfeited at 10 PM on the last night of the cruise.
policies.notes: Applies in the 48 hours after final payment.

policies.name: UK/Non-US-Canada 10% Program
policies.notes: Separate, more limited program for UK and other non-US/Canada residents.

lines.eligibility: US/Canada residents get full program; UK and other residents limited to the 10% program.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Celebrity.

lines.monitoring: Public fares on matching itinerary elements. Regional variation applies.

policies.name: Regional Price Protection
policies.notes: No guaranteed remedy; programs differ by region, booking channel, and fare type.

lines.eligibility: Varies by region and booking channel.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer; timing windows vary by applicable program.
